protocol: independent calibration/validation/test seeds; fixed DEM weights from explicit composition-specific calibration circuits; test shots paired across fixed, all specialists, and validation-selected oracle; no adaptation if the specialist gate fails

config.probability_fit: maximum detector-pattern likelihood over the configured grid; known composition family, no L0 labels
config.selector_validation: minimum residual count among fixed and four specialists, tie favors fixed; selected separately per condition
config.DEM: Stim approximate_disjoint_errors=True for mixed Pauli channels

usefulness_gate.criterion: lower paired test errors, Bonferroni-adjusted exact McNemar p<0.05, and seed-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero
